title: bheka.notice.issued.v1
description: Emitted by bheka-case (via bheka-notify orchestration) when a transparency_notice row is created and delivered to the data subject. CANON section 5 refusal 8: monitoring is never silent. Stream: NOTICE. Consumers: bheka-notify (delivery channel selection — email, WhatsApp, in-app), compliance audit pipeline. One event per notice per recipient (localisation creates separate events per language).

user_id.description: The data subject receiving this notice.

notice_type.description: Maps directly to the notice_type enum in transparency_notices (018_NOTIFICATIONS_AND_TRANSPARENCY).

language.description: BCP 47 language tag (e.g. 'en', 'zu', 'af', 'st', 'xh'). One of the five official SA languages per CANON section 16.

issued_at.description: When the notice was generated. Distinct from acknowledged_at which the subject sets.

delivery_channels.description: Channels bheka-notify should use to deliver this notice. Empty means in_app only.
